executive_summary: This lecture focuses on the transformer architecture and how it relates to natural language processing and learning. The curriculum focuses on the internal block structure of transformer encoders and decoders. BART combines a bi-directional encoder with an autoregressive left to right decoder. Finally, the module compares extractive summarization baselines against abstractive sequence to sequence models in educational applications.
